newsitem.title: USA: Alliance Semiconductor loses vice president. [CORRECTED 20:30 GMT 12/9]
newsitem.headline: Alliance Semiconductor loses vice president. [CORRECTED 20:30 GMT 12/9]

text.p: (Corrects to "vice president" in headline to conform with text)
Alliance Semiconductor Corp said Friday that Ron Shelton, its vice president, finance and administration and chief financial officer, had submitted his resignation.
The California company said only that Shelton was leaving to pursue another opportunity. It added that Shelton's responsibilities will be performed by senior management until a successor is found.
Shelton could not be immediately reached for comment.
